name: Kenco MCS Jeffersonville III - Sellersburg IN

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (38.398626,-85.776916, APPROXIMATE) landed on farmland 2km NW. Resolved via web research to Silver Creek Logistics Center Building B, 7803 Highway 31 E, Sellersburg IN 47172 - the 417,270 SF Class A building (built 2019) exactly matches roster SF. Confirmed on satellite + Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open access driveway off Highway 31 E - no barrier arm, no gate, no guard booth. Confirmed via Street View (capture 2026-03): wide unobstructed paved entrance drive with only a monument sign. Modern logistics park, property is unfenced.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere at the entrance or on the access road.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - there is no truck gate at all, so remote guard-shack does not apply.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two large Class A buildings on one shared property: Building B (~417,270 SF, north/smaller, the roster facility) and Building A (~660,450 SF, south/larger). Shared access road and drop yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Building B is ~350m long; dock bank faces SW toward the central drive aisle with many trailers backed in. 25-50 band is a conservative estimate from a single visible dock face; full-site count higher.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large paved trailer drop area in the central aisle between the two buildings, full of parked trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and generous paved drive width with room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge of Sellersburg IN, a small town; adjacent residential subdivision but broader setting is small-town/rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs parallel to Highway 31 E along the east property edge but no spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~55 trailers counted across the central drop yard and dock aprons in zoom-19 imagery; approximate.
